slot_notes: Each semantic slot follows the inspected source object and binding sequence. Labels, dates, numbers, states, and rich-text runs retain their layout roles. Example text is illustrative modernization planning content.
style_notes: Source profile restores exact inspected RGB bindings. The alternate teal emphasis changes only the headline and two section-heading text objects on white. Step-number ovals, cutover state cells, matrix fills, legal/footer text, and logos retain source colors. Geometry, type, theme colors, and artwork are unchanged; native color/fit qualification remains unmeasured.
opaque_areas: Cutover state-cell fills and step-number colors remain source phase encodings; legal/footer/page fields are outside the contract.
retained_source_content: West Monroe brand assets and legal/footer/page content remain from the source.
The original legal line and page number remain source text outside the editable contract.
limitations: Fixed source geometry; longer replacement text may not fit.
Source graphics are preserved and may retain source-specific visual context.
No claims of native fit, reflow, or visual qualification.
scenario: Illustrative modernization planning scenario. Dates, durations, measures and work products are examples for planning discussion, not client results, testimonials, staff assignments or commitments.
